codingMemberRoleOf.reason: SW11 inspection: legacy codingMemberRoleOf consumes the stored metadata Members list, including its missing-user guest fallback, rather than authoritative SQL WorkspaceRole. WorkspaceMember has no direct ID and is an unsplittable metadata root array, so existing point scopes cannot select one member. Requires bounded legacy-member storage support; replacing it with SQL WorkspaceRole changes semantics.
